verdict.rationale: vLLM docs explicitly list 'Streaming outputs' as a core feature and provide an OpenAI-compatible API server, which natively supports streaming token responses (SSE) as in OpenAI's API. Community evidence corroborates the OpenAI-compatible API usage but does not specifically discuss streaming behavior firsthand. Missing for 10: dedicated streaming API documentation/example and independent hands-on confirmation of token-by-token streaming.
